title: Saw Doctors musical playing to full houses in Galway
story: playing to full houses in Galway
takes centre stage in the new Shamtown music show, which is playing to packed-out audiences in the Mick Lally Theatre in Galway city this week. The
, based on the background, formation and early success of The Saw Doctors, is by turns poignant, nostalgic, heart-breaking and hugely uplifting. Written by the band's

Ollie Jennings, the two-hour production gives a captivating insight into the events that combined to form the group, remembering the contributions of Tuam luminaries past and present, while honouring the universal appeal of the band's music, over almost four decades.
